people.title: People
people.emptyBody: Add them one at a time or import an Excel file with everyone at once.
people.spouseHint: If their spouse is also on the list, they'll stay together when groups are made.
people.activeHint: Turn off if they're not coming this time.
people.deleteBody: They'll be removed from the list. Saved groupings won't change.
people.occasionalHint: Doesn't come often. Occasional people are spread across groups so none ends up short-handed.

import.title: Import from Excel
import.intro: Upload an .xlsx file with one person per row. The first row must contain the column names:
import.spouseTip: For married couples, enter the spouse's full name in “Spouse”. They'll always be linked so they stay together in groups; if the spouse has no row of their own, they're added to the list. You can also put both in one row, like “John and Mary”: they're split into two married people.
import.found: No people in the file | 1 person found | {n} people found
import.rowErrors: 1 row won't be imported | {n} rows won't be imported
import.replaceHint: Deletes your current {n} people before importing.
import.addedSpouses: Added to the list as spouses: {names}
import.invalidFile: Couldn't read the file. Make sure it's an Excel file (.xlsx).
import.noNameColumn: Couldn't find the “First name” column. Check the first row or use the template.

create.title: Create groups
create.replaceBody: The current groups aren't saved and will be lost when you create new ones.

groups.balanceAgeHint: Only counts people whose age is set.
groups.resultHint: Tap a person to move them to another group.
groups.historyEmpty: Groupings you save will appear here.
groups.notEnough: You need at least 2 participants to make groups.
groups.emptyBody: Clustr sorts the people on your list into groups based on your criteria.
groups.deleteSetBody: This saved grouping will be deleted. People aren't affected.
groups.noCurrentBody: Choose your criteria in Create and your groups will show up here to adjust, export or save.
groups.spreadOccasionalHint: So no group ends up short-handed if they don't come.
